questions.question: Who gathered to David in the cave of Adullam?
options: The priests and Levites from Nob
The trained soldiers of King Saul's own army
The kings of the surrounding nations

questions.question: What terrible thing did Saul order at Nob?
options: The killing of the priests who had helped David
A sudden and shameful retreat from the battlefield
A great feast to celebrate his reign as king
A binding treaty with all the Philistine cities
questions.answer: The killing of the priests who had helped David

questions.question: Doeg the Edomite carried out the slaughter of the priests of Nob.
About four hundred men gathered to David in the cave of _____.
Saul had the priests of _____ killed for helping David.
